title: Travelers Spend Over $200 on Pre-Trip Pampering
paragraphs: Many people like to look their best when they go on vacation. According to new research, this is becoming more expensive.

The research was done by Clearpay, a "buy now, pay later" company, and it was reported in July 2026. It found that travelers in the UK planned to spend an average of £158 each on beauty products and treatments before their summer vacations. Depending on the exchange rate, that is roughly $200. It was 27% more than in 2024, when the average was £124. On average, people planned to spend £74 on products and £83 on treatments.
People who travel farther spend more. For example, people going to the United States planned to spend £237, and people going to Italy or France planned to spend £206.

The most popular treatment before a trip was a haircut. Other popular treatments were manicures and pedicures, facials and hair coloring. Sales of some products also grew a lot. For example, Clearpay's sales of aftersun lotion more than doubled, and sales of teeth whitening products rose 37%.

Men are also spending more on beauty before trips. In the survey, 76% of men and 82% of women said they treat themselves before they travel. Shakaila Forbes-Bell, a psychologist who works with Clearpay, said that "Looking and feeling your best before you travel is all about confidence."
Why do people do this? The most common reason was to look and feel their best on vacation, at 44%.
However, some people do not have time. In a different survey by the company Treatwell, 21% of travelers said they did not get a beauty treatment before their trip because they were too busy.
